item.title: 4 suspects from Indianapolis face murder charges in Delaware County vehicle fire
item.description: Four suspects from Indianapolis have been charged with murder, arson, kidnapping, and obstruction of justice for their roles in a vehicle fire in rural Delaware County that resulted in the discovery of human remains.

item.title: IMPD: Missing autistic teen ‘likely’ fell in White River; recovery mission underway
item.description: Indianapolis police have transitioned their search for a missing autistic teen, Robert "RJ" Williams Jr., to a recovery mission after finding his backpack and gym bag on a dock along the White River, suggesting he may have fallen into the water.

item.title: Indianapolis family celebrates arrival of New Year’s baby
item.description: Ascension St. Vincent welcomed a baby girl named Yasmin, the first baby born in 2026, weighing 8 pounds, 3 ounces and measuring 20.08 inches long, to parents Grace and Luis from Indianapolis.

item.title: Teen shot while driving crashes into tree, dies at hospital, IMPD says
item.description: A driver was found with a gunshot wound in a crashed vehicle on the near east side of Indianapolis, and later died at the hospital, prompting the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department to search for suspects.

item.title: Shelbyville resident charged with aggravated battery after shooting
item.description: A Shelbyville, Indiana, man on Friday was formally charged with aggravated battery, battery by means of a deadly weapon, intimidation, criminal trespass, and distribution of an intimate image in connection to a shooting that happened 11 days earlier.

item.title: Man arrested for drunk driving in fatal New Year’s crash on West 79th Street
item.description: An Indianapolis man was arrested for drunk driving after causing a fatal car crash on New Year's Day, resulting in one death and preliminary charges of operating a motor vehicle while intoxicated causing death.

item.title: Dentist, wife found dead in Columbus, Ohio, home; police seek help
item.description: A respected dentist and his wife were found dead in their Columbus, Ohio, home with two young children unharmed. Police are investigating the double homicide with no obvious signs of forced entry and no firearm found at the scene.

item.title: Shooting at downtown Lugar Tower leaves 2 women injured
item.description: Two women were injured in a shooting at a downtown Indianapolis housing complex on Friday night, and one person was detained.

item.title: Hoosiers fans return home after Rose Bowl victory
item.description: Thousands of Indiana University football fans on Friday returned home victorious from the Rose Bowl, where they celebrated a 38-3 win over Alabama in the College Football Playoff.

item.title: 4 rifles taken from Crawfordsville department store; ATF seeks tips
item.description: A person stole four rifles from a Crawfordsville, Indiana, department store on the evening of Dec. 30, 2025, and federal authorities and a shooting sports group are offering a possible reward for information.
